what: Only allow linking slides that go to different outputs

introduction.message:
Only allow linking slides that go to different outputs

Both slides need specific outputs with none in common. A stored link that
becomes invalid shows as two single slides. Also documents the song copy
and the disabled updates/signing in AI_README.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

latestEdit.message:
Add output-aware backgrounds, show-level outputs and linked slides

- Background inheritance on slide click now only uses slides meant for each output, including output-specific clear-background cues
- Shows can be sent to specific outputs from the show context menu (slide bindings override)
- Two neighbouring slides can be linked into one card that activates both on click
- Document the output targeting and linked slide paths in AI_README.md

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

what: Only remove from the arrangement when deleting a group in the arrangement bar

introduction.message:
Only remove from the arrangement when deleting a group in the arrangement bar

Right clicking a group in the arrangement order had no menu, and Delete
went through the normal slide delete, which removes the slide from the song.
Groups in the arrangement bar now get a "Remove group" menu and Delete only
removes them from the arrangement, the group stays in the show.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
